title: Research Philosophy
summary: My research brings artificial intelligence and machine learning together with blockchain and secure distributed systems, with particular emphasis on healthcare applications and drug discovery. I emphasize reproducible evaluation, transparent limitations, privacy, and responsible interpretation of computational results.

pillars.title: AI/ML with healthcare relevance
pillars.description: Frame computational questions around healthcare data, medical IoT, and drug discovery, linking methods to clearly defined research objectives.

pillars.title: Explainability and rigorous evaluation
pillars.description: Assess predictive performance alongside interpretability, robustness, data quality, and reproducibility; distinguish model results from clinical benefit.

pillars.title: Privacy and distributed trust
pillars.description: Investigate federated learning, blockchain, and security mechanisms for accountable data collaboration without assuming that any one technology guarantees privacy.

pillars.title: Interdisciplinary translation
pillars.description: Pursue collaboration with domain specialists and appropriate validation before making claims about clinical readiness.

pillars.title: Open scholarly communication
pillars.description: Document methods, assumptions, and limitations clearly so others can assess and extend the research.

callout: Intelligent healthcare research needs rigorous evidence, explainable methods, and trustworthy data systems.
